notes.title: Shio | Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello, I’m Devvi from the Shio’s team. The long-awaited story update is now available. The new contents are as follows. 

1.	We’ve changed the game process. Player will wake up at a lake house at the beginning. You can return to it by using ‘Yuki's face’ at any time. 

2.A variety of collectibles have been added to the game. These items can be found through the game. They will offer you additional information about the story. Each item indicates that ‘I’ am not a man without past. ‘I’ was just so sick of it that ‘I’ forgot it. 

3.We added a ‘diary’ into the game. It can be picked up at the lake house at the beginning. By checking the diary, player can see a word or two that ‘I' wrote down before. You can also check the diary for information about the collectible items and writings found in the hidden levels. 

4.The collectible items you found will be displayed in the lake house. 

5.Player can now take ‘Yuki's face’ at the lake house directly at the beginning. 

6.The story of chapter one ‘The sun also rises’ is redesigned. 

7.Some levels are improved to provide a better experience.

notes.title: Shio | Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 

After short development process we added new feature, which is minimap. We hope this new feature will help you explore the world of Shio.

1.1.4 patchnotes:

- Minimap
In this update, we have added minimap. Players can open of the current level. Map feature will be available on both game modes, simple and difficult mode.

- UI optimization

Players can interact with world use "E" key on keyboard or "L1" button on controller.

Also, we are about to start working on "story update", thanks for you patience.

Dev team

notes.title: Shio | Test Branch Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hey there! This is Gao, one of the developers of “Shio”. We update a new element in the test branch——Mini Map, and players are needed to improve this function. You're welcomed to join this test, and also your advice and suggestions.

Notice: The "Mini Map" is ONLY available in chapter 1.

How do you get into the test branch?
YOU MUST backup your save before entering the test branch, otherwise all the current game progress would be lose after the test!!!
Archive Site of Windows: C:\Users\user name\AppData\LocalLow\CoconutIslandStudio (please show the hidden documents)
Archive Site of Mac: ~/Library/ApplicationSupport/unity.CoconutIslandStudio.SHIO

"Library"> "Shio"> "Properties"> "BETAS" and enter the beta access code "OldPeterIsCrazy", choose the "Shio new mode test".

If you have any problems or advices, please post a message in steam's community hub.

Peter Ge that having less than on money after the steam Summer Sale

"Shio" | Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! My name is Gao and I’m one of the developers of “Shio”. In the new update version 1.0.5, we fixed some bugs and some performance issues. If you have some feedback, feel free to comment below.

	Update version 1.0.5 will have:

	1.Fixed BUG when in walking state, charactor shows jumping animation .

	2.Fixed BUG when players press left and right buttons at the same time and then release one of the buttons, character won't move.

	3.Fixed BUG that time record shows unexpectedly.

	4.Improved rain performance in Chapter 4.

	Hope this update will improve your' experience.

Peter Ge
2017.5.18

Official release date for "Shio" is 5 May!
notes.notes:
"Shio" is just around the corner! Game producer Liao Yi said, that game will be ready for official launch on May 5th! Right now, "Shio" is at the last stage of last optimizations and testing!

The game will skip Early Access stage and will be ready for full release.
If you don’t want miss official launch, simply add our game to your wish list.
